task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Lift the toycar with glossy finish using the left arm, drop it in the brown basket with woven ridges, then push the brown basket with woven ridges via the right arm.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架后用左臂抬起光面玩具车，将其放入棕色编织篮中，然后用右臂推动棕色编织篮。
